title: ViPE: Video Pose Engine for 3D Geometric Perception
evidence: Abstract says ViPE estimates intrinsics, camera motion and dense near-metric depth from unconstrained raw videos; supports pinhole, wide-angle and 360-degree panoramas.
supports: M2 uses ViPE as near-metric pose/depth source
do not call ViPE depth unconditionally metric
no evidence here for external-pose-conditioned ViPE inference

title: MapAnything: Universal Feed-Forward Metric 3D Reconstruction
evidence: Official README multi-modal example accepts img, intrinsics, camera_poses and is_metric_scale=True; it specifies OpenCV cam2world convention and exposes depth_z/pts3d outputs.
supports: M3/M4 interface-level pose-conditioned MapAnything design
required coordinate convention and metric-scale bookkeeping

title: OpenVINS documentation
evidence: Official documentation describes an open-source visual-inertial estimator/research platform; metric scale depends on calibrated camera-IMU data, timing, initialization and excitation, so it is not a guarantee of zero drift.
supports: M3 metric-pose rationale
report calibration, initialization, tracking loss and drift

title: GPT-6 Astra Model | OpenAI API
evidence: Official model page lists text and image input, text output, Responses API, function calling, hosted shell, computer use, MCP and image generation support. It does not establish an industry-impact claim.
supports: public capability statement for Astra
separate official capability from this project's measured Blender results

title: Hydra: A Real-time Spatial Perception System for 3D Scene Graph Construction and Optimization
evidence: Official README cites Nathan Hughes, Yun Chang and Luca Carlone, RSS 2022, and says the code incrementally builds 3D scene graphs in real time.
supports: semantic/hierarchical scene-graph precedent
avoid claiming traditional SLAM only produces trajectories or point clouds

title: Holodeck: Language Guided Generation of 3D Embodied AI Environments
evidence: Official README links arXiv:2312.09067 and describes language-guided generation of AI2-THOR environments, including queries such as a living room; this is generation, not real-video reconstruction.
supports: language-to-executable-environment adjacent work
do not present as metric reconstruction

title: SceneScript: Reconstructing Scenes With An Autoregressive Structured Language Model
evidence: ArXiv title and abstract identify an autoregressive structured-language-model approach to scene reconstruction.
supports: structured scene-program representation precedent
do not attribute Blender or metric guarantees without evidence

title: Real2Code: Reconstruct Articulated Objects via Code Generation
evidence: ArXiv title identifies reconstruction of articulated objects via code generation; scope is articulated objects rather than complete rooms.
supports: editable articulated-object/code representation as adjacent work

title: Lab kitchen twin
evidence: Project page says a 21-second phone walkthrough yields a metric scan and modelled 3D kitchen; it reports 210 frames, 37 assets and GPT-6 Astra-authored assets from the ViPE scan.
supports: closest public demonstration of the proposed scan-to-Blender direction
demonstration evidence rather than independent peer-reviewed baseline

title: LiteReality-Agent
evidence: Official README describes turning real-world scans into simulation-ready 3D environments with articulated assets, colliders and robotics simulation export; it labels the technical report coming soon.
supports: engineering-adjacent real-scan-to-simulation reference
do not treat as a published technical paper
